checks: correction starts from the exact changed version and walks Archive reverse references breadth-first within a declared depth
each edge records exact dependent/dependency versions, reference use, locator and depth; same-theme or textual similarity is never inferred as dependency
a replacement source correction must be a later version of the same object and the current object version; withdrawal/license changes can omit a replacement
requested adoption decisions must have subjects inside the explicit dependency closure
active version-level UseRestriction records are appended for every explicitly affected version before the correction case is presented as ready for impact review
W15 is_current checks the active restriction for its exact subject before any READY adoption can be considered current
W33 blocks current body/reuse use under restriction while historical as-of body replay remains available under rights
an unrelated adoption/Article outside the explicit graph remains current and unrestricted
the correction case records the scope actually searched and a separate scope limitation rather than claiming a complete global dependency map
every explicit dependent must receive one MAINTAINED/NARROWED/RETRACTED/UNRESOLVED/NOT_AFFECTED classification
MAINTAINED needs remaining exact support; NARROWED needs both retained scope and remaining support
RETRACTED/UNRESOLVED cannot retain an approved scope
impact review records next owner, unsearched scope and assessor without automatically lifting any restriction
recovery needs an archived Review that references both the exact target version and the exact assessed correction case
recovery scope cannot exceed the correction's original restriction scope
allowed new W15 decisions must be READY, bind the target and recovery Review, cover only recovered scope and differ from the blocked decisions
the correction record keeps old decision IDs and appends allowed new decision IDs; old READY decisions do not automatically revive
retracted content cannot be restored under the same version; a new version/review is required
